claims.head: Minnesota plays fast; Florida slows it down
claims.body: On pace, Minnesota sits 7th of 32, at the fast end of the scale. Florida is 27th, at the slow end.

notes.text: B. Faber has not played this season. J. Spurgeon is in his usual spot beside Q. Hughes, up from second-pair minutes last season. O. Maatta has moved into Spurgeon’s old spot beside J. Brodin.

FLA.head: Nothing to separate these two
FLA.body: The two have been about even at controlling the play lately and Florida has home ice. For Florida, the difference could be keeping the shots to the outside.
